name: Admin Maintenance
summary: Administration flows for dunnage types, parts, specs, inventory, icons, and maintenance dialogs used to keep master data current, including timer-backed add-type validation cleanup, persisted custom-field definitions with normalized database column names, Edit Type management for saved custom fields, PNG image selection and preview for dunnage types and parts, choice-based spec definitions for quick-add type and part dialogs, part-specific extra spec rows on Quick Add Part and Edit Part, and a reusable existing-spec-template picker that lets Quick Add Part and Edit Part reuse saved spec sets.

userActions: Add new types and parts quickly
Upload and clear PNG images for dunnage types and parts
Persist Add Type custom-field definitions with a consistent insert and delete database contract
Manage saved custom fields for an existing type from Edit Type
Reuse an existing part's saved spec values when adding or editing a part
Add part-specific key/value specs when quick-adding or editing a part
Define a spec field with a controlled list of allowed choices
validationHints: Confirm admin maintenance flows still edit the intended records
Confirm quick-add dialogs still feed the correct admin screens
Confirm type and part dialogs retain a selected PNG when reopened from draft state
Confirm clearing an image removes the stored relative path on save
Confirm Quick Add Part and Edit Part can temporarily close, open the existing-spec picker, and reopen with the selected specs applied
Confirm choosing existing specs reuses only the saved spec values and notes, without forcing the source part ID or inventory type
Confirm Quick Add Part and Edit Part can save extra part-specific specs alongside the configured type specs
Confirm part-specific specs reject duplicate names and reserved keys that collide with configured specs or Notes
Confirm Quick Add Type shows the hidden choice editor only when the Choices spec type is selected
Confirm Add Type custom fields save with a normalized DatabaseColumnName and can be deleted through the Dunnage custom-field stored procedure path
Confirm Edit Type loads persisted custom fields, supports add/edit/delete, and saves the final state back to dunnage_custom_fields
Confirm admin list pages and selected-part spec summaries still refresh correctly after whole-collection replacement
Confirm Quick Add Part and Edit Part render Choices specs as dropdowns using the configured array values
Confirm Edit Part no longer shows hardcoded width, height, or depth inputs and instead renders any dimension fields from the saved type spec definitions
Confirm the Add Type dialog tears down its validation timer when the dialog closes
